Question to be asked - “What’s in your lunch box today?
Which one is your favourite?”



Shoot Instructions (Clear + Practical) not video instruction 
1. Anchor Positioning
Anchor should sit or kneel at child’s eye level
Not standing over them (very important for comfort)
Keep posture relaxed, slightly leaning forward
2. Shot Setup
🎬 Shot 1: Opening (Anchor)
Medium close-up (waist-up)
Anchor looking at child, not camera
Natural smile

👉 This is where the line is delivered

🎬 Shot 2: Lunch Box Reveal
Close-up of lunch box opening
Capture hands opening, not staged
🎬 Shot 3: Child Reaction
Close-up of child’s face
Expression: excitement / curiosity
🎬 Shot 4: Food Close-ups
Quick cuts of items inside
Colorful, neat but not overly styled
🎬 Shot 5: Child Answering
Medium shot
Let child speak naturally
A little peek into their lunch boxes—and their favourites too. From tiny bites to big smiles, it’s always the simple moments that matter.

At Junior Toes, teaching goes beyond lessons — it's about creating memories that last a lifetime.
This time, our little ones got a night entirely of their own — a Pyjama Party.
They walked in and were welcomed with so much warmth. Sipped on their healthy, yummy welcome drink. Struck their best poses at the selfie booth.
Then came the real fun — games, dancing, and oh — they absolutely slayed the ramp walk like tiny little stars.
Movie time rolled in, munching on snacks, and the smiles? Priceless.
And then — the best part of the night. A bonfire. Where little ones sat together, shared their experiences, and a few surprised everyone by showcasing their hidden talents.
And then came dinner time — plates were full, hearts were fuller.
Good night whispers filled the room…
And when morning came, they stretched, they jogged, they showed up. 
Fresh, bright and full of life.
Because joy, confidence and togetherness-are lessons too.
Little hearts. Big experiences.
Junior Toes — where every experience shapes a little life

Junior Toes Pyjama Party – A Night Full of Fun, Learning & Memories

At Junior Toes, learning goes beyond the classroom — it’s about creating meaningful experiences that shape young minds. Our recent Pyjama Party for kids was a magical evening filled with fun, laughter, and unforgettable memories.

The night began with a warm welcome, where children enjoyed a healthy welcome drink and captured joyful moments at the selfie booth. The excitement continued with engaging kids’ activities, including games, dancing, and a delightful ramp walk, where our little stars confidently showcased their charm.

As the evening unfolded, it was time for a cozy movie night, complete with delicious snacks and endless smiles. The highlight of the night was the bonfire session, where children bonded, shared experiences, and even surprised everyone with their hidden talents — building confidence and communication skills.

A wholesome dinner followed, filling not just their plates but also their hearts. As the day ended, the room echoed with soft goodnight wishes, creating a comforting and secure environment for every child.

The next morning started with refreshing activities like stretching and jogging, helping children feel energized, active, and ready for the day ahead.

At Junior Toes, we believe that joy, confidence, social skills, and togetherness are essential parts of early childhood education. Events like our Pyjama Party encourage children to explore, express, and grow in a nurturing environment.

Junior Toes – Where Little Hearts Create Big Memories.

At Junior Toes, learning goes beyond books.
And today, our young explorers stepped into a whole new world 
The world of post, a place that has been quietly connecting hearts, families, and stories for centuries.
And for our explorers, it felt like stepping into something truly magical.

Inside, the learning came alive.
From understanding how a letter travels — from one pair of hands to another, across streets, across cities, across lives —
to discovering stamps, addresses, and postal procedures —
every single thing was experienced hands-on.
Not read about. Not watched on a screen.
Lived. Felt. Understood. 

But the most special moment of the day?
Watching our little ones pick up a pencil and write their very own first letter. 
And then walking up to the postbox themselves, holding that envelope, and letting it go.

Because at Junior Toes, we believe learning doesn't have to be confined to a classroom.
It can be joyful. It can be wonder-filled. It can be fun.
